name: wireless-technologies-and-rf-engineering
description: Wireless Technologies — RF, Standards, Building and Programming: why wireless is hard, propagation and the link budget, modulation and multiple access, antennas, spectrum and regulation, Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi in practice, Bluetooth and BLE programming, NFC and RFID, Thread, Zigbee and Matter, LoRa and LPWAN, cellular and cellular IoT, UWB, choosing a radio, antenna integration, certification, low-power design, provisioning and onboarding, RF debugging, wireless security, coexistence, and positioning and sensing.
